name: smwmusic-kirby-super-star-invincibility
title: Kirby Super Star - Invincibility
description:
The iconic Invincibility Lolipop theme from Kirby, from how it appeared in Kirby Super Star.

If you are using a version of AddmusicK before 1.0.9, change the #define amkversion in the text file to 0 (Insert size will be 0x020C bytes)

And there is more information in the Readme if you plan on using this as a global song.

Requested by Aaron_Grella.
